h: Pantami vows to expose those behind an alleged plot to end his Gombe governorship bid
p: Former minister Isa Ali Pantami has reportedly vowed to expose people he says are plotting to end his Gombe governorship ambition. The statement follows the ongoing INEC review of his candidacy.
more: INEC is reportedly deciding on the candidacy question.
He did not name those he accuses, according to the reports.
